bifrost: springboard/src/gpu/ (GPU presenter for rendering and scanout only); springboard/render/src/glass.rs (glass blur hook); no tensor or graph API in the SDK
summary: MPSGraph is a symbolic tensor compute graph that compiles to GPU, CPU and Neural Engine executables. BifrOSt has no tensor type, graph compiler, ML runtime or compute API for apps. Its GPU code (springboard/src/gpu/) only draws the desktop and handles scanout, and the Neural Engine has no Linux counterpart.

gaps: No tensor or symbolic graph API for apps. A desktop SDK would need a graph type, a compiler and executables before any ML feature could land.
No app-facing GPU compute submission or completion callbacks. springboard/src/gpu/ serves only the compositor.
No neural-network operators (convolution, pooling, RNN) or FFT and random ops on the GPU.
No serialized executable format and no compilation cache.
Neural Engine has no counterpart. Only the device-capability query in springboard/src/gpu/plan.rs exists, and it is not exposed to apps.
